task: scGPT whole-human zero-shot: Replogle essential held-out perturbation prediction (K562)

model.name: scGPT whole-human pretrained (bowang-lab/scGPT)
model.source: hf-mirror perturblab/scgpt-human (re-upload of bowang-lab/scGPT whole_human best_model.pt)
model.inference_protocol: canonical zero-shot masking: perturbed gene value masked to -1 in ctrl cells, mlm_output read for all tokens; pred_expr = pool mean; unmasked positions are identity reconstructions

eval_protocol.label_definition: pearson_delta = Pearson(pred_delta, true_delta) on top-50 |true_delta| genes; pearson_delta_all on all matched genes (same as local step1_run.py / scgenept run)
eval_protocol.true_mean: mean of condition cells in perturb_processed.h5ad
eval_protocol.ctrl_mean: mean of ctrl cells in perturb_processed.h5ad
eval_protocol.caveat: 零样本 mask 协议下未扰动位置预测≈输入，pearson_delta 主要反映扰动基因单点及其邻域；pred_pert_gene_value 单独留痕
eval_protocol.target_not_in_input_space: 目标基因不在输入空间的扰动无法 mask，预测≈ctrl（138/217，同 scgenept 数据事实）
